name: HISTORICAL GENESIS
description:
Historical Genesis is the first chapter of Arctavis.

A limited series of foundational works inscribed on the Litecoin blockchain .
Each piece represents a symbolic moment in technological evolution and decentralized history. 

Only 15 genesis inscriptions. 
Permanent. On chain. Immutable.

name: HISTORICAL GENESIS
description:
HISTORICAL GENESIS is a monumental digital chronicle inscribed directly on the Litecoin blockchain.

This collection explores the birth and evolution of a cryptographic republic from the Genesis Spark of 2011 to the institutional era, privacy amendments, scalability revolutions, and the rise of digital culture. 

Each piece is permanently inscribed onchain as an immutable artifact, forming a historical layer within Litecoin itself. 

Created in a hybrid visual language that merges American monumentalism, sci-fi minimalism, amd mid poly geometry, the collection presents blockchain not merely as technology - but as architecture, law, labor, and energy. 
42 inscriptions. 
One narrative. 
A republic of code. 

Authored by Arctavis.
